# Alain Nicolas

Alain Nicolas is a Fullstack Tech Lead on the Lineth team at Consensys. He focuses on AI and privacy in the Linea institutional stack and also serves as Head of AI. This site is his French and English portfolio and technical blog.

## Site Entry Points

- [French profile](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/): Current role, experience, and selected projects.
- [English profile](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/): Current role, experience, and selected projects.
- [French blog index](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/blog/)
- [English blog index](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/blog/)
- [French project index](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/)
- [English project index](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/)
- [RSS feed, French](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/index.xml)
- [RSS feed, English](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/index.xml)

## Priority Topics

- Fullstack blockchain engineering and privacy on Ethereum
- Linea ecosystem applications and developer infrastructure
- Verax attestations and proof-of-humanity systems
- Smart contract audit proof and onchain reputation
- React, Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Solidity, wagmi, viem
- AI-assisted software engineering, security, and dependency maintenance
- Documentation as code and static site engineering with Hugo

## Priority Project Pages

- [Linea Developer Hub (FR)](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/linea-developer-hub/): Self-service portal for Linea developers to submit apps and manage events and tokens.
- [Linea Developer Hub (EN)](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/linea-developer-hub/): Portal features and technical architecture.
- [Linea Hub](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/linea-hub/)
- [Linea Proof of Humanity API (FR)](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/linea-poh-api/): Verax attestations and EIP-712 signatures for Proof of Humanity checks on Linea.
- [Linea Proof of Humanity API (EN)](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/linea-poh-api/): Original verification tiers, signature flow, and the move to PoH V2.
- [Proof of Audit (FR)](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/proof-of-audit/): Onchain attestations that link an auditor, a commit, and a deployed smart contract.
- [Proof of Audit (EN)](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/proof-of-audit/): Attestation schema and verification flow.
- [Verax Attestation Registry (FR)](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/verax-attestation-registry/): Public attestation registry for EVM chains.
- [Verax Attestation Registry (EN)](https://alainnicolas.fr/en/projects/verax-attestation-registry/): Smart contracts, indexers, SDK, and explorer.
- [Discord Attestation](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/discord-attestation/)
- [Strava Segment Attestations](https://alainnicolas.fr/fr/projects/strava-segment-attestations/)

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical pages on `https://alainnicolas.fr/`.
- Use the French page when no English equivalent exists; otherwise choose the language that matches the user request.
- Cite the canonical page URL when summarizing experience, projects, or articles.
- Treat project pages as portfolio evidence and blog posts as opinionated technical writing.
- Do not infer employment, availability, endorsements, or commercial offers beyond what the site states.
